kitDescription: E.H. is a Wind-element SMG Attacker whose Burst III swaps her weapon. She accumulates Scrap — 10 granted at battle start, plus income when her team destroys projectiles, destroys enemy parts, or neutralizes enemies — and whenever she holds 10 Scrap while below the cap, she crafts a homemade magazine (up to 4), permanently gaining 7.5% ATK per magazine held. Each time she obtains Scrap she also gains 16.36% elemental advantage attack damage for 15 seconds. Her burst swaps her SMG for a 0.4-second charge weapon dealing 61% of final ATK per shot (250% of that on full charge), loaded with one round per homemade magazine and ending early once those rounds are fired, while also granting her 430.05% ATK for 10 seconds. On the scope-lock partless solo boss only the battle-start Scrap grant exists, so she fights with exactly one magazine: +7.5% ATK all fight and one charged shot per burst.

verdictRationale: All 11 kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP; zero REAL-GOTCHAs. The blind S5 suite runs GREEN (20 passed / 3 skipped) against the shipped override once its own harness-wiring artifacts are repaired — the pristine 11 failures were observable-shape bugs in the blind test, not faithfulness divergences, and the 3 skips are the same three scrap-source lines the driver records verbatim in unmodeled. Convergence is strong where it matters: driver and both blind agents independently derived the load-bearing 1-magazine steady state (start 10 / consume 10 / rebuild 0), killing the 30%-ATK and 4-round-swap over-credit traps. Where the blind agents diverged from the driver, the prose + formula side with the driver: S6's bossElementGate 'Water' is a blind-agent misread (Wind beats Iron; the gate would silence the line on the advantaged boss) and S6's missing maxShots would refire the swap ~5× per window — both are RECON_ERROR-class findings against S6, not the driver. The driver's documented approximations (fused-passive E5, static maxAmmo/maxShots 1, pool-clamp carrying the '<4 magazines' gate half, ⚑ swap-exit reload) are exact at scope and carry recipes, never fudges. Discrimination holds: every load-bearing assertion has a named counterfactual that moves the observable (0/4-magazine worlds, Damage-Up-bucket stat, Fire-boss byte-identity, no-chargeMult, noMaxShots, fullBurstEnter re-key). Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the magazine-persistence judgment call (kit never states the burst consumes a magazine; driver + S2b concurred on persist, so every cast loads 1 round) and the static-at-scope maxAmmo link are shared-prior readings no blind party independently challenged from footage — a real E.H. recording confirming one swap shot on her SECOND burst cast would close the loop.
